verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's own docs show service icons, favorites pinned to the top, a vague 'Organize with ease' claim, and search, which the changelog implies through its search deep links. All of this is thin marketing or changelog wording. No source documents folders, groups or tags. Missing for 10: documented folders/groups/tags for organizing tokens, a dedicated search feature description, in-depth docs on icon coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: Easily identify your tokens by their icons
Added support for search deep links via enteauth://search.
